A guide value is not a seller quote. Cardmarket offers can differ by condition, language, shipping and seller location.

Recommended blend: A’s visual style with B’s goal-first workflow. Keep the history chart optional until guide-value history is trustworthy.

Proposed changes: summary dashboard, checklist search, condensed card controls and price provenance. Existing routes do not provide all of these yet.

Safe interaction: the “Mark owned” button only demonstrates feedback here. Production must preserve multi-printing ownership before adopting a one-click action.
